name: chatgpt-exchange-landscape
title: ChatGPT Exchange (landscape)
description: A dark ChatGPT exchange types and sends a prompt, streams an answer, assembles a four-row comparison table and scrolls back through the result: the app's black to the frame edge, the app column with header and Russian keyboard in the middle. Prompt, answer, table and six beat times are variables; holds the read-back frame to the end of the mount.
author: Jake Moran
